entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Five dragons hatched from luminous spheres of overlapping mana, who founded Strixhaven.

events.summary: As the demiplanes Ezroi and Karudis merge, Arcavios is born and five powerful vortices of mana become spheres from which five dragons hatch.
events.quote: Five particularly powerful vortices of overlapping mana became luminous spheres

events.summary: The dragons found an institution for the study of the five mana dichotomies, now known as Strixhaven.
events.quote: So, centuries ago, the dragons founded an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies
